attributes.description: Distribution opsdir-adapter-azure (import opsdir_adapter_azure), registered via entry point opsdir.adapters:azure; depends on opsdir, opsdir-format-terraform, opsdir-format-arm and opsdir-adapter-x509 (Key Vault certificates' public facts).
attributes.external_dependencies: ["hashicorp/azurerm Terraform provider", "Azure CLI", "Azure Key Vault REST API (certificates, api-version 2025-07-01)"]
attributes.purpose: Azure provider: Terraform (hashicorp/azurerm) from infrastructure bindings with pinned NSG priorities, and Bicep / ARM JSON translated from the same Terraform data (render targets bicep and arm: the arm_render ARM target on format-terraform's native engine plus the arm_types table, 5.6; a template per deployment scope, lookups as existing resources, parts inline where a parent's PUT would drop them); azkv secret resolver; owns azkv/azkv-key/azblob schemes; Key Vault certificates (every version) read as a certificate manager's inventory (importer azure/keyvault-certificates + az rest GET-only collector, task 564).

attributes.name: certificate_facts
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "pem", "type": "str", "required": true, "description": "PEM text whose first certificate is read"}]
attributes.purpose: {serial, sha256, subject, issuer, not_before, not_after, usages, endpoints, names} of a PEM's first certificate: serial as even-length lowercase hex, SHA-256 as ciamFingerprint, RFC 4514 subject/issuer, validity as GeneralizedTime, extended key usages as OIDs (None without), revocation endpoints ((kind, url), ...) and the DNS names and IP addresses it names (subject common names, then alternative names: ciamCertificateName's); None when no certificate
attributes.returns: {"type": "dict | None", "description": "{serial, sha256, subject, issuer, not_before, not_after, usages, endpoints} or None"}

attributes.name: page_path
attributes.purpose: Where a source's certificate listing page n (0: the first) is kept in the export

attributes.name: versions_path
attributes.purpose: Where page n of a certificate's version listing is kept

attributes.name: version_path
attributes.purpose: Where a certificate version's answer (its public certificate) is kept

attributes.name: policy_path
attributes.purpose: Where a certificate's policy is kept

attributes.name: pending_path
attributes.purpose: Where a certificate's pending operation is kept (absent: none pending)

attributes.name: vault_path
attributes.purpose: Where a vault-wide answer (contacts, issuers) is kept

attributes.name: sources
attributes.purpose: The collection sources an export holds (each with a first listing page), in order

attributes.name: id_parts
attributes.purpose: (certificate name, version or None) a Key Vault certificate id names (https://<vault>/certificates/<name>[/<version>]), or None

attributes.name: pages
attributes.purpose: ((n, the page's document or None), ...) of a paged listing whose page n is kept at path_of(n), from the first up to the first page missing

attributes.name: thumbprint
attributes.purpose: A certificate's SHA-1 thumbprint as ciamThumbprint writes it, from Key Vault's x5t (base64url), or None

attributes.name: epoch_time
attributes.purpose: GeneralizedTime of Key Vault's seconds since 1970 (nbf, exp), or None

attributes.name: lifetime_actions
attributes.purpose: ((action type, when), ...) of a certificate policy's lifetime actions, when in words (80% of its lifetime, 30 days before expiry, or None)

attributes.name: management
attributes.purpose: What the vault does for a certificate as ciamManagement says it: enrolled (AutoRenew), monitored (EmailContacts only) or unassigned; None when the policy wasn't read; action types matched case-insensitively

attributes.name: authority
attributes.purpose: The issuer a certificate's policy renews it through as the vault names it (Self, Unknown, or a configured issuer with its provider), or None

attributes.name: issuer_providers
attributes.purpose: {issuer name: provider} of the vault's configured certificate issuers

attributes.name: contact_emails
attributes.purpose: The email addresses of the vault's certificate contacts

attributes.name: pending_problems
attributes.purpose: What a certificate's pending operation reports wrong now (failed or canceled, in Key Vault's words), or ()

attributes.name: policy_facts
attributes.purpose: The managed certificate facts a certificate's policy gives every version of it: ciamManagement, ciamManagedAuthority, ciamManagerContact (when it has a lifetime action), ciamManagerAction, ciamManagedOrigin added

attributes.name: version_facts
attributes.purpose: The managed certificate facts of one version: from its public certificate (cer via x509 certificate_facts) when read, else from its version listing item (thumbprint, validity); path, enabled state

attributes.name: certificate_rows
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "files", "type": "dict", "required": true}, {"name": "source", "type": "str", "required": true}, {"name": "vault", "type": "str", "required": true}, {"name": "name", "type": "str", "required": true}, {"name": "current", "type": "str|None", "required": true, "description": "the listing's x5t"}, {"name": "providers", "type": "dict", "required": true}, {"name": "contacts", "type": "tuple", "required": true}]
attributes.purpose: ((cn, facts), ...) of every version of one certificate oldest first, with (versions unread, version answers unread, policy unread): policy facts on each, ciamRenewedAs (the next version's cn) on each but the newest, the pending operation's problems on the current version

attributes.name: read_source
attributes.purpose: (Imported group, notices) of one collection source: its vault's managed inventory (complete/incomplete/denied with problems) and every version of every certificate

attributes.name: read_keyvault_certificates
attributes.purpose: Importer azure/keyvault-certificates: per collection source in the export, its vault's certificate manager inventory, replacing the record's

attributes.name: kept_page
attributes.purpose: Keep function (bound to the vault's address with partial): a certificate listing page reduced to items' id, x5t and dates (tags dropped), nextLink and the vault's address (Vault); an error answer kept as its error; non-JSON kept as is

attributes.name: kept_listing
attributes.purpose: Keep function: a version listing page reduced as a listing page is (without the vault's address)

attributes.name: kept_version
attributes.purpose: Keep function: a certificate version's answer reduced to id, x5t, cer and dates (kid, sid, policy, tags dropped)

attributes.name: kept_policy
attributes.purpose: Keep function: a certificate policy reduced to issuer, lifetime actions, subject/sans/validity and enabled (key and secret properties dropped)

attributes.name: kept_pending
attributes.purpose: Keep function: a pending operation reduced to status, status_details, cancellation_requested, error code/message and issuer name (CSR dropped)

attributes.name: kept_contacts
attributes.purpose: Keep function: the vault's certificate contacts reduced to emails and names (phones dropped)

attributes.name: kept_issuers
attributes.purpose: Keep function: the vault's configured issuers reduced to ids and providers

attributes.name: vault_of
attributes.purpose: (the vault's address, the token audience) a source's location names in a cloud (public: vault.azure.net, usgovernment: vault.usgovcloudapi.net), https and nothing after the host; None otherwise

attributes.name: keyvault_steps
attributes.purpose: Collector steps: per readable source's vault, az rest GETs (api-version 2025-07-01, --resource the cloud's audience): listing pages (nextLink only on the vault's own address), contacts, issuers, then per certificate version pages, policy, pending, then each version's answer (at most DETAIL_CALLS)

attributes.name: keyvault_problems
attributes.purpose: Why the collection sources can't be read: their own problems, or a location naming no vault of the environment's cloud

attributes.name: der_pem
attributes.purpose: The PEM of a certificate given as base64 of its DER (a store API's certificate: Key Vault's cer), or None when the text isn't base64 of DER

attributes.description: From deferred note 3248 (file 1131). Azure Key Vault certificates (list / versions / get / policy) are a MANAGED/discovered certificate inventory on task 562's model (flow 80, ou=managed-certificates, ciamManagedInventory per vault; an absent certificate never confirms one missing), not a CA's issuance record. Build an importer (and read-only collector on the core collection helpers) in opsdir-adapter-azure: certificate facts via opsdir-adapter-x509 certificate_facts and reasons.reason_name; the policy's issuer (Self, Unknown, a DigiCert/GlobalSign issuer name) and lifetime actions (AutoRenew/EmailContacts, days/percentage before expiry) are the managed inventory's facts; contacts -> ciamManagerContact where the model has it. Check Azure Government (vault.usgovcloudapi.net) and Azure public endpoints and current api-version on official docs (record the sources; report disagreements). Metadata only: never the certificate's private key, never the secret behind it. Acceptance: unit tests, showcase change + golden diff reviewed by the master, README/docs; live validation deferred to 7.2 as a deferred note.
attributes.name: Azure Key Vault certificates as a managed certificate inventory

attributes.description: Official docs: list/versions/get/policy shapes, api-version, endpoints per cloud, least-privilege read role; sources recorded
